subject: Access of app.R and data in shiny-server outside app possible?

messages.author: 2b46f14139c84304
messages.subject: Access of app.R and data in shiny-server outside app possible?
parts:
Hi,

1.) I'am writing a MediaWiki extension which embeds Shiny app code into MediaWiki. The wiki copies the app code into the shiny-server app directory which is outside the Apache document root. Since the MediaWiki is run by the Apache user, I created a subdir in the shiny-server app directory which can be accessed by the Apache user. Could the app.R files be accessed somehow?

2.) For an specific app I have confidential data. If I put them in a data directory of the app can the data files itself accessed (except from the app)?

Thanks in advance

Sigbert
